capability: Write the sound to the picture's own clock
title: Every sound on the tick.

hook.picture: Close on the whale dragging a music strip under the line. The hits land a hair after each picture change. It nudges, and the next hit slips.
hook.words: I'll just nudge the music a bit.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The music never hits the moment the picture changes.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: the edit gets shorter three times (every 2 beats, then 1, then half). Each time the whole music strip slides out of step at once.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: The music and the picture keep separate clocks.

stakes.body: Hours of nudging, redone after every edit, and the film still feels off.

solution_hint: Place each sound on the picture's clock.

metaphor.body: Ticks sit on the line at each picture change. Each sound is a ring written onto a tick, so when the edit moves, the ticks move and the rings move with them.

steps.picture: Ticks drop onto the line at each picture change. A small ring blooms on each tick: a sound written at that moment.
The whale shortens the edit. The ticks move with the pictures, and the rings move with the ticks. Nothing slips.
steps.words: Change the edit. The sound moves too.
steps.sound: Hits stay locked as the tempo tightens.

steps.picture: Push-in: the whale deletes a shot. Its tick and ring vanish together, and the next ring sits on the next tick in the same frame.
steps.words: Rebuilt in seconds, from the same list.
steps.sound: One hit drops out cleanly, then the rest.

steps.picture: The counter of sounds matches the counter of ticks.

real_case.claim: Motion Atlas node 'Code-synthesized audio' (proven): music and sound effects written as code and rendered to WAV, giving exact sync, zero licensing risk and a seconds-long rebuild.

honest_limit.picture: Every sound lands exactly on its tick, but one is a harsh beep that no check notices. The code that writes it cannot hear it.
honest_limit.words: On time is not the same as good.

not_this.body: The code can't hear it. You must.

ending_pattern.body: The whale trims a shot as in FELT, but drags nothing. Every hit stays locked on its cut and the pod answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: Same close shot of the strip under the line as bar 1, now nothing slips.

end_belief.body: Tie each sound to the moment it marks.
